'''Sapphires''' were gemstones valued by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. They could be worth anywhere from twenty-five to fifteen thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per [[Coruscant Standard Carat]].

The [[Ankarres Sapphire]] was a particular sapphire.
